title: Progress of "30 By 30" Food Production Goal Given Recent Farm Closures
what_it_is: Progress of "30 By 30" Food Production Goal Given Recent Farm Closures

sections.label: 30 by 30 vision
sections.summary: The "30 by 30" vision was conceived in 2019 to build capacity to locally produce 30% of nutritional needs by 2030, but the business climate has become less favourable.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The "30 by 30" vision was conceived in 2019 as an ambitious aspiration of building the capacity and capability to locally produce 30% of our nutritional needs by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Since then, the business climate has become less favourable due to factors such as the COVID-19 pandemic, geopolitical tensions and inflation.

sections.label: Post-pandemic challenges for farms
sections.summary: In the post-pandemic period, inflation, energy price hikes exacerbated by geopolitical tensions, and a more challenging financial environment have added to challenges.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Since then, in the post-pandemic period, inflation and energy price hikes exacerbated by geopolitical tensions, as well as a more challenging financial environment, have added to their challenges.

sections.label: Farm numbers remain stable
sections.summary: Despite some farm closures, existing players expanding and new players entering have kept total land- and sea-based farms relatively stable at about 250 since 2019.

sentences.text: That said, while there have been some farm closures, we are also seeing existing players looking to expand their operations as well as new players entering the agri-food sector.
So, overall, the total number of land- and sea-based farms have remained relatively stable at about 250 since 2019.

sections.label: ACT Fund enhanced 2022
sections.summary: In 2022 the ACT Fund was enhanced to extend the higher 70% co-funding, or up to $6 million per project, to more food types such as fruited vegetables, mushrooms and shrimps.

sentences.text: In 2022, the ACT Fund was enhanced to extend the higher co-funding quantum of 70%, or up to $6 million per project, to a wider range of food types, such as fruited vegetables, mushrooms and shrimps, allowing more farms to benefit from this higher co-funding.

sections.label: Local egg production share
sections.summary: Local egg production now contributes more than 30% of local consumption, an increase from 26% in 2019.

sentences.text: For example, our local egg production now contributes more than 30% of local consumption, an increase from 26% in 2019.

sections.label: ACT Fund awards to companies
sections.summary: As of 30 April this year, SFA has awarded $25.7 million to 42 companies under 68 awarded projects.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: On the utilisation of the ACT fund and what is the extent of the projects being funded, as of 30 April this year, SFA has awarded $25.7 million to 42 companies under 68 awarded projects.

sections.label: Farm energy cost measures
sections.summary: Farms can adopt measures to defray some operating energy costs, but directly offsetting operating expenses is challenging and could have a perverse effect.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: These are measures that farms can adopt to defray some of their operating energy costs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But to directly offset operating expenses, that will be something quite challenging because it could well end up having the perverse effect of paying for inefficient players to offset their costs to the detriment of taxpayers' money as well.

sections.label: Hawker group buying with SAFEF
sections.summary: Hawkers have established supplier relationships that are hard to change, but SAFEF will work with keen hawker groups on group buying and longer-term contracting models.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But it is not a straightforward issue of trying to ask the hawkers to buy from the aggregator because many of these hawkers and businesses have already established relationships with specific suppliers, and it is probably not so easy for them to change this kind of relationship overnight.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But if there are particular hawker associations, particular groups of hawkers in a particular locality, who are keen to come together to do some group buying, I think SAFEF will be prepared to work with them and discuss longer-term contracting models where there is more constancy of supply with good quality and there is also better demand for the farmers themselves.
